meta.disclaimer: All numbers are estimated placeholders based on historical GTA Online mechanics and community leaks. Verified values will be patched on official game launch.

activities.name: Port Gellhorn Container Depository
activities.source: PLACEHOLDER - Community Speculation & Cayo Perico Baseline
activities.notes: Best solo grinding heist estimate. Primary loot plus randomized secondary duffel bag loot (cash, cocaine, gold).

activities.name: Vice City Superyacht Syndicate
activities.notes: Requires at least 2 players for dual keycards. Highest payout per run when running with 2 coordinated players.

activities.name: Leonida Commercial Reserve Bank
activities.source: PLACEHOLDER - Pacific Standard / Doomsday Act 3 Scaled
activities.notes: Maximum co-op challenge. Demands 4-person crew. Heavy getaway damage can reduce base payout up to 20%.

activities.name: Bayshore Exotic Auto Import/Export
activities.notes: Top-tier exotic car delivery. Low cooldown if alternated with VIP contracts. Minimal fencing fee.

activities.name: Everglades Smuggler Air-Drop
activities.notes: Low radar sea-plane interception. High risk of interceptors in contested sessions.

activities.name: Ocean Drive VIP Club Passive Stock
activities.notes: Passive warehouse delivery. Single armored vehicle run. 100% of payout goes to seller.

activities.name: Little Haiti Chop Shop Salvage
activities.notes: Quick turnaround mini-heist. 3 preps and 1 quick 7-minute finale.

activities.name: Florida Keys Offshore Speedboat Run
activities.notes: Coastal watercraft escape route. High $/hr when running solo in private crew session.

activities.name: Vice City Security Transport Ambush
activities.notes: Instant sticky-bomb ambush. Great filler activity while waiting out heist prep cooldown timers.

activities.name: Malibu Nightclub Cash Vault
activities.source: PLACEHOLDER - Auto Shop Robbery Contract Scaled
activities.notes: Stealth infiltration through VIP lounge tunnels. High bag value if player drills safety deposit boxes.
